labeling.independence: labels come from base.json (names, source text, resolved call edges, LLVM CFG) or were hand-authored; no LLM enrichment, embedding or retrieval output was used
labeling.behavioral_review: single annotator (AI-assisted authoring); not independently reviewed by a second person
labeling.caveat: structural categories are labelled from the same call graph used by graph expansion

categories.control_flow: Control-flow questions answered from the LLVM CFG
categories.callee: What does function X call (direct callees)
categories.multi_hop: Multi-hop structural reachability (graded by hop count)

unsupported_categories.dependency: the `dependencies` field is empty for every function in base.json, so no dependency ground truth exists
